test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

CORRECT : ROCRTCE :: WRONGLY : ORWNYLG :: NEUTRAL : ?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Given word : First and third, fifth and seventh letter of the given word are exchanging their position with each other while other letters are at their own position.**

For, CORRECT : ROCRTCE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1f0eef7b83b6e0fe8083493103aaa19be06a5601c0e40f2e9e1f0d6cca2ec67.png] 

For, WRONGLY : ORWNYLG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc546859c749098f11d6d5d262abd596910291dba7acac6ad278395fe0c3c6c0.png] 

Similarly, NEUTRAL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bca27eb300a754bde00bc01dc253e291020334627293d571022440c167d23c9.png] 

So, **NEUTRAL **will be **UENTLAR.**

Hence, the correct answer will be ***'Option 2'.***
